whyMatters.en: Teignmouth trio that scaled prog/alt riffs, falsetto leads, and classical pastiche into 2000s arena rock; Black Holes and Absolution–era peak.
whyMatters.zh: 廷茅斯三人组：把 prog/alt riff、假声主唱与古典拼贴扩成 2000 年代体育场摇滚；Black Holes 与 Absolution 时期为峰。

shortBio.en: Matt Bellamy–led arena alternative; Knights of Cydonia is the maximal single.
shortBio.zh: Matt Bellamy 领衔的体育场 alternative；Knights of Cydonia 是最大化单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1994. Origin of Symmetry (2001) and Absolution (2003) built the template—heavily compressed guitars, arp synths, operatic falsetto, conspiracy/sci-fi lyric frames.

Knights of Cydonia (2006) stacks Morricone pastiche and stadium riff. They occupy the UK arena lane beside Radiohead’s experimental path: same generation, louder crowd-chant design.
body.zh:
1994 年组建。Origin of Symmetry（2001）与 Absolution（2003）建立模板——高压缩吉他、琶音合成器、歌剧式假声、阴谋/科幻歌词框架。

Knights of Cydonia（2006）堆叠 Morricone 拼贴与体育场 riff。与 Radiohead 的实验路径同代，占据英国体育场车道，更强调集体口号设计。
